title: Flimblegoon Resourse pack
description: This is a custom made Flimblegoon Resourse pack for christmas
body: It features a festive Christmas-themed GUI, decorative Christmas lights on leaves, and a custom holiday-style hitmarker to add seasonal flair to combat. Designed specifically for the Flimblegoon SMP, it adds warm, festive visuals while keeping gameplay fully vanilla-friendly. Perfect for celebrating the holidays on the server.
